caption: energetic synth pop anthem with confident female vocal, wide pads, driving bass, tight drums, glossy mix, D major, 110 BPM
lyrics:
[verse]
Thunder rolling in my chest
Racing forward, never rest
Electric skies and silver wings
Rising up on brighter things

[prechorus]
Louder now the drums will call
Nothing breaks us when we fall

[chorus]
We are fire, we are light
Burning through the velvet night
Every star will know our name
We will never be the same

[verse]
Horizons opening so wide
With your hand right by my side
Golden dawn on distant shores
This is what the sun is for

[chorus]
We are fire, we are light
Burning through the velvet night
Every star will know our name
We will never be the same

[outro]
